```{r}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(1236)
```

## Mean and SD

check CLT using simulation.

```{r}
source("source/sim_mean_and_sd.R")
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
```


```{r}
output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000){
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)
```

```{r}
output |>
  bind_rows() |>
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |>
  bind_rows() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

Let's do this using tibbles and maps instead.

```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |>
  unnest(est_df)
```

look at results.

```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

## change `n`

```{r cache=TRUE}
sim_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  )|>
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |>
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  )|>
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  )|>
  group_by(samp_size) |>
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean))

```
